    The indecomposable skeleton of the standard-form algebra #

    The restricted-Yoneda recovery equivalence identifies the original standard mesh vertices with a duplicate-free complete family of modules on the projective vertices. The finite-category algebra equivalence then transports that literal Fin S.n family to the standard-form algebra.
